spans.s: 1 शर॑ m. reed, arrow.
2 शर m. sour cream.
3 शर (˚—) water.

 m. course, way (only —˚).
शरकाण्ड s. reed-stalk.
शरकार m. arrow-maker.
शरक्षेप m. an arrow's throw or flight.
शरगुल्म m. a thicket of reeds.
शरगोचर m. an arrow's reach or flight.
शरजन्मन् m. E. of Skanda (the reed-born).
शरजाल n. a thick shower of arrows.
शरज्ज्योत्स्ना f. the autumnal moon-shine.
1 शरण n. falling asunder, decay.
सरण a. & n. running.
सारण n. causing to go, dismissing.
शरणागत a. come for refuge, seeking protection.
शरणार्थिन् a. seeking protection.
शरणैषिन् a. seeking protection.
शरणालय m. place of refuge.
शर॑णि f. obstinacy, pertinacity.
सरणि f. way, path.
सारणि f. small river, channel.
शरतल्प m. a couch made of arrows.
शरत्काल m. the autumnal season.
शरत्पद्म n. an autumnal lotus-flower.
शरत्पर्वन् n. a full-moon night in autumn.
शरत्पर्वशशिन् m. the full moon in autumn.
शरत्समय m. the autumnal season.
शर॑द् f. autumn, pl. also = year.
शरदण्ड m. reed-stalk.
शरदिज a. born or produced in autumn, autumnal.
शरद्वधू f. autumn conceived as a woman.
शर॑द्वन्त् a. advanced in years (autumns), aged.
शरधि m. receptacle for arrows, quiver.
शरन्मेघ m. an autumnal cloud.
शरपञ्जर n. = शरतल्प.
शरबन्ध m. a thick shower of arrows.
शरबर्हि॑स् n. reed-straw.
शरभङ्ग m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
शर॑भृष्टि f. reed-point.
शरम॑य f. ई consisting or made of reeds.
शरवण n. a thicket of reeds.
1 शरवर्ष m. a shower of arrows.
2 शरवर्ष n. rain (of water).
1 शरवर्षिन् a. raining arrows.
2 शरवर्षिन् a. raining (water).
शरशयन n. = शरतल्प.
श॑रस् n. cream, the scum on boiled milk.

स॑रस् n. trough, bucket;
 pool, pond, lake.
शरस्तम्ब m. a thicket of reeds.
शरारि f. a kind of heron.
शरा˚री f. a kind of heron.
शरारु a. harming, noxious.
शरावाप m. bow or quiver (arrow-scatterer).
शरास m. ˚न n. bow (arrow-thrower).

सारस f. ई relating to a pond or lake. m. a cert.
aquatic bird (f. ई), a man's name.
शरासार m. a shower of arrows.

सारासार n. strongness or weakness, worth and
worthlessness.
शरास्य n. the same.
सरस्य॑ a. belonging to pools or lakes.
शरिन् a. having arrows.
स॑रिन् a. hastening (to help).

सारिन् a. hastening;
 following (—˚).
सरिर॑ n. the heaving flood.
शरीरक n. a (small or inferior) body.
शारीरक a. corporeal.
शरीरकर्तृ m. father (body-maker).
शरीर˚कृत् m. father (body-maker).
शरीरकर्षण n. tormenting the body.
शरीरग्रहण n. taking a bodily form.

शरीरज a. sprung from or belonging to the body, bodily;
m. embryo, son, love or the god of love.

शरीरत्याग m. the sacrifice of life (lit. giving up
the body).
शरीरदण्ड m. corporal punishment.
शरीरदेश॑ m. region or part of the body.

शरीरधातु m. chief part or element of the body
(blood, flesh, etc.).

शरीरधृक् a. bearing a body;
 m. living creature.

शरीरपात m. death (lit. falling or breaking down of
the body).

शरीर˚भेद m. death (lit. falling or breaking down
of the body).
शरीरयष्टि f. a slender body.
शरीरयात्रा f. bodily subsistence.

शरीरवृत्ति f. = शरीरयात्रा.
शरीररत्न n. a jewel of a body.*

attendance.
शरीरशोषण n. emaciation of the body.
शरीरसाद m. bodily exhaustion.
शरीरस्थ a. being in the body.
शरीराकार m. bodily shape.
शरीरान्त m. the hair (lit. end) of the body.
शरीरान्तकर m. destroyer of bodies.

शरीराभ्यधिक a. dearer than one's own person or
body (friend).
शरीरार्ध m. the half of the body.
शरीरावयव m. a part of the body.
श॑रु f. (m.) spear or arrow.
स॑रु m. = श॑रु.
श॑रुमन्त् a. armed with a spear or arrows.
शरौघ m. shower of arrows.
शर्कराम्बु n. sugar-water.
शर्करोदक n. the same.
श॑र्कु m. N. of an evil demon.
शर्को॑ट m. a cert. snake.

2 श॑र्ध m. troop, host.

श॑र्धनीति a. leading the host (of the Maruts) or
acting boldly.

2 श॑र्धस् n. = 2 श॑र्ध.
†शर्धिस् (only —˚) defiant, strong.
श॑र्ध्य s. a cert. part of a waggon.
शर्मक m. pl. N. of a people.
शर्मकारिन् a. causing welfare or happiness.
शर्म˚कृत् a. causing welfare or happiness.
†शर्मण्य a. protecting.

श॑र्मन् n. cover, protection, shelter, refuge, comfort,
welfare, joy, bliss (often —˚ in Brahman-names).
शर्मय् only शर्मय॑न्त् protecting.
शर्मवन्त् a. containing the word श॑र्मन्.
शर्मिन् a. joyful, happy.

शर्मिष्ठा f. N. of sev. women, esp. of the wife of
Yayāti.

शर्यणा॑वन्त् m. pond, lake (cf. prec.), fig. of the
Soma-vat.
शर्यह॑न् m. archer (killer with arrows).
श॑र्यात m. names of men.
शार्यात॑ m. ई॑ f. patron. names.
शर्याति m. names of men.

शर्व॑ m. N. of a god killing with arrows, in l. l. =
Rudra-Śiva.
सार्व a. useful to all.
शर्वपत्नी f. Śarva's wife i.e. Pārvatī.
शर्वाचल m. = शर्वपर्वत.
शर्वाणी f. N. of the wife of Śarva or Śiva.

शारङ्ग s. bow*;
 f. ˚ङ्गी the female of a cert. bird.
शारद॑ f. शारदी॑ or शा॑रदी autumnal.
शारदीन a. the same.
शारदीय a. the same.
शारद्य n. autumn-corn.
शारद्वत m. a man's name.

शा॑रि m. = शार॑ m.;
 f. a kind of crow.

सारिक m. आ f. a kind of crow.

titles of works.
शार्ग॑ m. a cert. bird.
शार्ङ्गक m. ˚ङ्गिका f. = prec. m. & f.
शार्ङ्गधनुर्धर m. E. of Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa.

शार्ङ्ग˚धन्विन् m. = prec.

शार्ङ्ग˚भृत् m. E. of Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa.
शार्ङ्गरव m. N. of a man.
शार्ङ्गिन् m. = शार्ङ्गधनुर्धर.

 best among (—˚).
शार्दूलचर्म॑न् n. a tiger's skin.
शार्दूललोम॑न् n. a tiger's hair.
शार्दूलविक्रीडित n. tiger's play, N. of a metre.

शार्वर a. nocturnal;
 f. ई night.
शार्वरिक a. = prec. adj.
सरक n. cup, pot.
सर॑घ् s., सर॑घा f. bee.
सरट m. lizard, chameleon.
स॑रथ a. along with the chariot.

 cf mw, etc.}}#} a. riding in the same chariot.
सरन्ध्र a. having a hole (holes).

 ˚— & n. adv.
सर॑मा f. the bitch of Indra or of the gods.

सरमापुत्र m. the same.
सरमा˚सुत m. the same.
सर॑यु f. N. of a river.
(सरयू) f. N. of a river.

स॑रश्मि a. shining, radiant.

सरसि˚जाक्षी f. a lotus-faced (-eyed) woman.

 m. n. a creeping animal.

सर्ग˚कृत् m. creator.

स॑र्ग˚प्रतक्त a. moving along as if shot off.

omnipresent, universal.

number.

power.

 omnivorous.

सर्वाभाव m. absence of all.
